verses.mystical_translation: The ascent begins by refusing to let deceit and conflict define the tongue.
The poem enters through songs of ascents, lying speech, conflict, allowing what is real to be named before it is transformed.
Its center asks what becomes possible when memory, power, vulnerability, and desire are held in the presence of the Divine rather than acted out automatically.
